```plato

    // The trace: the sum of the main-diagonal elements, folded over the diagonal
    // indices via MapRange + Array.Reduce
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trace_(linear_algebra)). Precondition: the
    // matrix is square.
    Trace(self: IMatrix): Number
        => self.RowCount.MapRange(i => self.ElementAt(i, i)).Reduce(0.0, (acc, x) => acc + x);
```
